mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.user_id AS userId, p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.amount AS amount, p.pay_method AS payMethod, p.status AS status, TO_CHAR(p.paid_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS paidAt, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate FROM mingle_payments p LEFT OUTER JOIN mingle_subscriptions s ON p.id = s.payment_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC
